sources.title: Roblox Corporation Form 10-Q, quarter ended Sept. 30, 2026
Roblox Q3 revenue rises 16% as bookings fall 12% to $1.7 billion

lines.say: Roblox's revenue just went up sixteen percent. Its bookings fell twelve percent.
lines.show: Roblox's revenue just went up 16%. Its bookings fell 12%.

lines.say: Same three months. Here's how both are true.
lines.show: Same three months. Here's how both are true.

lines.say: First, the scale. About one hundred thirty eight million people play on an average day.
lines.show: First, the scale. About 138 million people play on an average day.

lines.say: But only about one point eight million pay on a typical day. That's about one in seventy seven.
lines.show: But only about 1.8 million pay on a typical day. That's about 1 in 77.

lines.say: Bookings are what players spent this quarter. One point seven billion dollars, down twelve percent.
lines.show: Bookings are what players spent this quarter. $1.7 billion, down 12%.

lines.say: Revenue is what Roblox gets to count. One point five seven billion, up sixteen percent.
lines.show: Revenue is what Roblox gets to count. $1.57 billion, up 16%.

scenes.label: months per purchase
scenes.note: The average life of a paying player

lines.say: Roblox counts most purchases as revenue over about twenty seven months.
lines.show: Roblox counts most purchases as revenue over about 27 months.

lines.say: So revenue can keep rising for a while, even after spending slows.
lines.show: So revenue can keep rising for a while, even after spending slows.

scenes.label: paid out in 3 months

lines.say: And Roblox paid game creators four hundred three million dollars in those three months.
lines.show: And Roblox paid game creators $403 million in those three months.

scenes.note: To game creators, July to September 2026

scenes.takeaway: Revenue isn't the same as money spent today.
